@copilot Update this PR directly by combining a narrowly scoped MDC-reader callback with event-specific suppression named suppressMdcEnrichment.

LoggingEventMapper currently calls loggingEvent.getMDCPropertyMap() directly, while the Java-agent CallAppendersAdvice wraps the entire mapper.emit(...) call in a scoped Boolean currentExportRead. Replace this with a configurable MDC-reader function on the internal LoggingEventMapper builder, defaulting to ILoggingEvent::getMDCPropertyMap so standalone library appenders keep their existing behavior and have no dependency on agent bootstrap classes. Configure the Java-agent mapper in LogbackSingletons with a reader that sets suppressMdcEnrichment to the exact event, calls event.getMDCPropertyMap(), and restores the previous value in finally. Keep that scope limited to the getter invocation, not the rest of mapping or LogRecordBuilder.emit().

Replace the shared LogbackMdcState Boolean holder and currentExportRead accessor with event-specific scoped state exposed as suppressMdcEnrichment(). The bootstrap holder can use Object to avoid a dependency on Logback. In LoggingEventInstrumentation.GetMdcAdvice, skip agent enrichment only when suppressMdcEnrichment().get() == event, using identity rather than equals, and preserve the null-to-empty-map behavior for that raw MDC read.

Remove the export-state wrapper from the appender instrumentation's CallAppendersAdvice. Remove the clearing/restoration of export state in the MDC instrumentation's LoggerInstrumentation.CallAppendersAdvice, retaining its event-context capture. Preserve logging call-depth ownership and exception cleanup. A nested log from a custom MDC getter has a different event, so its ordinary application appenders must still get normal trace/resource/baggage enrichment without resetting the outer event's suppression. Restore scoped state even when a getter throws.

This request intentionally supersedes earlier instructions to preserve suppression across the entire mapper emit call and synchronous SDK processing, and the earlier restriction against changing the shared mapper. Do not retain or reintroduce the removed global synchronous-processor callback/priming tests or add unrelated testing hooks. Preserve standalone library behavior, existing MDC selectors and application-owned enrichment-key values, event-name handling, null MDC, independent baggage export, and normal enriched application-appender output.

Keep the change focused on the Logback mapper and its Java-agent integration. Use the existing test infrastructure to cover the callback's default behavior and Java-agent-only use, nested getter logging with enriched nested/outer appender output and correct exported attributes, and exception restoration. Preserve all existing observable MDC regression coverage. Apply the narrowest relevant spotlessApply tasks directly before behavioral validation, and run the relevant focused library tests and baseline/latest-dependency mdcExportTest suites and their execution variants where feasible. Commit the changes to this PR's existing branch; do not create another PR.

@@ -20,6 +20,22 @@ Captured MDC, structured, logger context, Logstash marker, and Logstash structur
 attributes may contain sensitive information. Configure included and excluded patterns to limit
 the data exported as log attributes.
 
+MDC capture selects only the application's original event MDC. Trace IDs, span IDs, trace flags,
+resource attributes, and baggage added by the Java agent's Logback MDC instrumentation are available
+to application appenders and log patterns, but are not exported as MDC log attributes. Application-owned
+values under the same names, such as `trace_id`, `service.name`, or `baggage.foo`, remain selectable.
+Trace correlation is carried in the OTLP log record's trace and span fields independently.
+
+To export baggage as log attributes, configure the bundled baggage log record processor separately:
+
+```properties
+otel.java.experimental.log-attributes.copy-from-baggage.include=tenant
+```
+
+This exports the selected baggage entry as `tenant`, without a `baggage.` prefix. It is independent
+of `otel.instrumentation.logback-mdc.add-baggage` and the MDC capture selector, including when that
+selector excludes all MDC entries.
